summary: community.routeros api_info/api_modify can no longer disable some tool netwatch parameters, name-format in interface wifi provisioning, or script in ip dhcp-client.
questions: Can I disable the script parameter on RouterOS dhcp-client with Ansible?

answer_card.title: RouterOS parameters that can't be disabled
answer_card.answer_md: With `api_info` and `api_modify`, these can no longer be disabled: multiple `tool netwatch` parameters, `name-format` in `interface wifi provisioning`, and `script` in `ip dhcp-client`.
